# context

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/context
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`, no runtime dependencies.
- `Context` is an immutable read-only view; the owner of a branch keeps the
  `ContextController` and cancels it in `finally`.
- Cancellation is cooperative: call `assertActive()` between steps; nothing
  interrupts a blocking call. Map `remainingMs()` to transport timeouts.
- Deadlines are monotonic `hrtime()` nanoseconds, observed lazily; observing a
  child whose deadline is owned by an ancestor terminates the ancestor's whole
  subtree. A child deadline is never later than the parent's.
- `withTimeout()`: zero/negative → immediate deadline; oversized → saturates
  at `PHP_INT_MAX`. NaN/INF → `InvalidArgumentException`.
- `onTerminate()` returns an unsubscribe `\Closure(): void`; a terminated
  context detaches from its parent and drops its listeners.
- `withValue(class-string<T>, T)` shares the parent's state (no controller);
  lookup returns the nearest ancestor's value or null.
- Deadlines do not cross processes: send `(int) remainingMs()`, rebuild with
  `withTimeout($ms / 1000)` (capped by your own limit) on the receiver.

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Context;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\ContextCancelledException;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\ContextExpiredException;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\TerminationCause;

$root = Context::background(?TimeSource $timeSource = null);

[$ctx, $controller] = $root->withTimeout(2.0);       // [Context, ContextController]
[$child, $childController] = $ctx->withCancel();
[$capped, $c] = $ctx->withDeadline(int $absoluteNs);
$traced = $ctx->withValue(RequestId::class, new RequestId('r-1'));   // Context only
$traced->value(RequestId::class);                   // ?RequestId

$ctx->assertActive();      // ContextCancelledException (reason = previous) | ContextExpiredException
$ctx->isTerminated();      // isCancelled() || isExpired()
$ctx->remainingMs();       // ?float: null = no deadline, >= 1.0 active, 0.0 expired
$ctx->deadlineNs();        // ?int

$unsubscribe = $ctx->onTerminate(static fn (TerminationCause $c): null => null);
$unsubscribe();            // idempotent; no-op once the listener ran

$controller->cancel(?\Throwable $reason = null);

new ContextExpiredException(int $deadlineNs, ?\Throwable $previous = null);
```

Listener failures do not stop the cascade: every listener and child runs, then
one exception (or a `RuntimeException` chain for several) is rethrown from
`cancel()` / the observing call.

Queue recipe: one context per message with the TTR as timeout, `assertActive()`
before every step, ACK only after completion, NACK/dead-letter on
`ContextExpiredException`, cancel the controller in `finally`.

Testing: `Rasuvaeff\Context\Testing\FakeTimeSource` (`advanceNs()`,
`advanceMs()`; also the `Sleeper`, so `sleep()` advances it) and
`SteppingTimeSource($stepNs)` (moves on every read — race tests). Pass to
`Context::background($clock)`.

## 0.3.0 additions

```php
[$work, $c] = $ctx->withReserve(0.2);      // parent deadline − 200 ms; no parent deadline → withCancel()
$cleanup = $ctx->withoutCancel();          // values only: no deadline, not cancelled by the parent
[$job, $c] = $message->joinedWith($worker);// terminated when either is; earlier deadline; values from $message
                                           // same TimeSource required (two default clocks are fine)
$ctx->sleep(0.5);                          // min(0.5 s, remaining); throws Expired/Cancelled
foreach ($ctx->iterate($items, every: 1) as $k => $v) {}   // checks before pulling each element
$controller->requestCancel($reason);       // signal-safe: applied at the next check of the subtree
```

- Never call `cancel()` from a signal handler; use `requestCancel()`.
- A check costs ~0.2 µs; requested cancellations are applied ancestors-first.
- Adapters: read `remainingMs()` BEFORE `assertActive()` — after it, an expiry
  in between yields `0.0`, which curl/ClickHouse/MySQL read as "no timeout".

```php
final readonly class TenantId implements WireValue {
    public function toWire(): string;                     // what travels
    public static function fromWire(string $w): static;   // validate, throw on bad input
}
$codec = new WireCodec(['tenant' => TenantId::class], onInvalid: null);
$wire = $codec->encode($ctx);       // ['budget_ms' => int|null, 'values' => ['tenant' => '...']]; throws if terminated
[$ctx, $c] = $codec->decode($wire, Context::background(), maxBudgetMs: 30_000);
// decode never throws on input: bad budget ignored, unknown alias / failing fromWire() dropped
```
